h1bskavh.baseName: My Christmas 5ft Pre-Lit Christmas Tree with 200 LED Lights - Green
h1bskavh.variantName: My Christmas 5ft Pre-Lit Christmas Tree with 200 LED Lights - Green
h1bskavh.sourceDescription: Bring festive charm to your home with this 150cm artificial Christmas tree, featuring 550 PE and PVC branch tips for a full, realistic appearance inspired by a freshly cut evergreen. The two-tone foliage combines light green outer tips with darker inner needles to create natural depth and texture. Its hinged branches drop into place for quick assembly and fold back for compact storage after the festive season. With integrated LED lights, you can choose from eight lighting effects using the included remote control, adjust the brightness, set a 6-hour timer with an 18-hour automatic shut-off cycle, and switch the lights on or off with ease. The flame-retardant foliage and sturdy metal trunk provide durability and reliable support for your favourite Christmas decorations. Ideal for living rooms, lounges, offices and entryways, this pre-lit tree makes it easy to create a festive atmosphere. Specifications: Made from PE and PVC with 550 branch tips, integrated LED lights, eight lighting modes, remote control, adjustable brightness, a 6-hour timer, an 18-hour automatic shut-off cycle, hinged branches and a sturdy metal trunk. Dimensions: Height: 150cm. Width: 120cm. Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG

x7kmm5cf.variantName: Christmas Tree World 8ft Snowy Scots Pine Christmas Tree
x7kmm5cf.sourceDescription: Packed with character, the Snowy Scots Pine is one of our most charming trees. Unlike plain green Christmas trees, the Snowy Scots Pine comes with lightly flocked bottle brush style branches which draw the eye without stealing the show from your favourite festive decorations. The range is also the perfect choice for those unsure about going for a fully frosted Christmas tree. Where an all-over flocked tree could perhaps be a little too 'modern' for some tastes, the Snowy Scots Pine expertly balances the old with the new, providing a timeless artificial tree that all Christmas guests will adore. Picture shows 7ft tree in our range. And let's not forget the very best bit the Snowy Scots tree comes with pre-attached pine cones! It's this final festive flourish that makes it one of our most unique collections - and a favourite among the kids! Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. qykme30j.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Fairy Lights Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 120 cm
qykme30j.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Fairy Lights Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 120 cm
qykme30j.sourceDescription: This Artificial Pre-lit Christmas Tree with LED Light brings the festive joy directly to your home or outside area. Its trendy cone shape is all about elegance and simplicity, making it the perfect focal point for your indoor or outdoor holiday decorations. With warm LED lights creating a lovely ambiance, this tree turns your living room, garden, or terrace into a festive wonderland while keeping things stylish and minimalist. Whether it’s for parties or quiet evenings in, its gentle glow and modern look will fit right in. Complete Set: The Artificial Pre-lit Christmas Tree comes with beautiful warm white LED decorative string lights that give you a heartwarming festive glow. These energy-efficient lights sparkle without the hassle of tangling wires, so you can set up quickly and easily. Durability and Style: Made with PVC, this tree is UV resistant, keeping its vibrant look during the holiday season even in the sun. The strong steel frame makes it sturdy while the modern, cone shape blends well with today’s home decor. Versatile Placement: Great for both indoor and outdoor use, this tree can be the star of your living room or add charm to your garden or terrace. Its good looks and practical design make it easy to fit into various settings, boosting the Christmas spirit wherever it goes. Efficient Power Options: With its USB-powered lights, this tree offers convenience by connecting to any power source with a standard 5V USB connector (not included). You can easily place the tree wherever it looks best. Assembly and Care: Two people are needed for assembly, just follow the manufacturer’s instructions to set it up without a hitch. Looking after your tree is a piece of cake, so it stays a treasured part of your holiday celebrations for years to come. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PVC Tree height: 120 cm Bottom diameter: 68 cm Stand size: 30 cm Durable Lifelike branch tips Number of PVC tips: 250 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

ygyyppmn.variantName: Neo Luxury 50cm Extra Large Frosted Pink Flowers Wreath
ygyyppmn.sourceDescription: Add a welcoming seasonal touch to your home with this decorative wreath, designed with a full arrangement of artificial foliage and decorative details to create an attractive display. The layered design provides plenty of texture and depth, making it an eye-catching addition to your seasonal decorations. Ideal for displaying on front doors, internal doors, walls, porches, hallways or above fireplaces and mantelpieces, the wreath can be easily incorporated into a variety of home settings. Its artificial construction means no watering or ongoing maintenance is required, and it can be carefully stored away after use ready for future seasonal displays. Suitable for decorative use, the wreath provides a simple way to update your home throughout the season and can be displayed on its own or coordinated with other seasonal decorations. Measuring approximately 50cm in diameter WARNING: For decorative use only. This product is not a toy. Keep out of reach of young children and pets, as small decorative components may become detached and present a choking hazard. Keep away from open flames, candles and other direct heat sources. Do not place near sources of ignition. Check the wreath regularly for loose or damaged components and discontinue use if damaged. Ensure the wreath is securely mounted when displayed to prevent it from falling. Packaging materials should be kept away from children and disposed of after unpacking. Neo Direct Ltd, Butterley Street, Leeds, LS10 1AW, United Kingdom
